item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 22/Mar/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of an anticyclone aloft, the weather will be generally fine over the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. Winds will be weak. The temperature difference between day and night will be rather large. A southerly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong midweek next week. It will be humid and visibility will be relatively low in some areas. It will be hot during the day. The northeast monsoon is expected to reach southern China in the latter part of next week. There will be a few showers over the region and there may be thunderstorms over inland areas. It will become cool over the weekend.
